subject: Mobile Development
title: Smartphones and Mental Health
description: One-minute skill: Smartphones and Mental Health.

hook.text: Since 2012, teen depression and anxiety rates have climbed sharply. Smartphones are a suspect.

buildup.text: Social media on phones delivers constant comparison, notifications, and dopamine hits.

discovery.text: Research shows a correlation between heavy phone use and reduced sleep quality.

twist.text: Correlation isn't causation. Phones also provide crisis hotlines and therapy apps.

climax.text: The debate over smartphones and mental health is far from settled — the data is complex.

punchline.text: Phones may harm and help mental health.

quiz.question: What has risen alongside smartphone adoption since 2012?
